summary: This study is testing semaglutide nasal spray, a drug given through the nose, in adults who are overweight or have obesity. Researchers want to see how the body processes the medication and how well participants tolerate single doses. Pharmacokinetic measures track how the drug moves through the body over time. The trial is sponsored by Shanghai World Leader Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. and is currently recruiting 60 participants.
